arxiv-2402-16332.title: Lower bound for large transversal fluctuations in exactly solvable KPZ models
arxiv-2402-16332.creator: Xiao Shen
arxiv-2402-16332.description: Abstract \vskip-12.0pt The study of transversal fluctuation of the optimal path has been a crucial aspect of the Kadar-Parisi-Zhang (KPZ) universality class. In this paper, we establish a new probability lower bound, with optimal exponential order, for the rare event in which a given level of the optimal path has a large transversal fluctuation.

pmc-11643847.title: Advances, Challenges, and Applications of Graphene and Carbon Nanotube-Reinforced Engineering Ceramics
pmc-11643847.creator: Alaa Almansoori, Katalin Balázsi, Csaba Balázsi, Guohai Chen, Dai-Ming Tang
pmc-11643847.description: Engineering ceramics and their composites are widely used owing to their excellent properties, including high wear, corrosion and heat resistance, low friction coefficient, and low thermal conductivity; thus, the current paper presents a comprehensive review of the most common types of engineering ceramics, demonstrating their key properties, advantages, potential applications, and challenges.

pmc-12683079.title: Cardiorenal Safety Markers With Injectable Glucagon-Like Peptide-1 (GLP-1) Agonists in Type 2 Diabetes: A Network Meta-Analysis
pmc-12683079.creator: Abigail Rai, Mahesh Kolli, Gaurav Pratap Singh, Rishu, Chao Yuan Li Cai, Hariharasudhan Balaji, Bendangjungla Pongen, Sandra Joy, Shahid Sai A.K.
pmc-12683079.description: Type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) markedly increases the risk of cardiovascular and renal complications, emphasizing the need for therapies that extend benefits beyond glycemic control. Injectable glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1 RAs) have demonstrated both cardioprotective and renoprotective potential, but the comparative efficacy of individual agents remains uncertain.

pmc-12783788.title: Mechanisms of pile-soil stress and deformation in excavations under the coupled effects of excavation disturbance and extreme rainfall infiltration
pmc-12783788.creator: Xiaorui Wang, Yu Zhang, Wenwei Li, Jianhang Xiao, Fei Tan, Chunhui Huang
pmc-12783788.description: Under the increasingly frequent extreme rainfall events, deep excavations are subjected to complex coupled effects of excavation-induced disturbance and rainfall infiltration, making it essential to clarify the deformation mechanisms of surrounding soils and retaining structures. In this study, a typical metro foundation pit in Zhengzhou was selected as the research object.

pmc-12972782.title: Endoscopic stenting as salvage therapy for high-risk Boerhaave’s syndrome patients
pmc-12972782.creator: Khalid Bhatti, Samuel Wiltshire, Sufia Laulloo, Lydia M. Y. Chang, Christopher Ball, Vinutha D. Shetty
pmc-12972782.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundSpontaneous oesophageal perforation (Boerhaave’s syndrome) is a life-threatening emergency with significant morbidity and mortality. Surgical repair remains a key component of management for selected patients; however, many high-risk patients are unsuitable for operative management. This article discusses how, in these high-risk individuals, minimally invasive strategies such as the use of covered self-expanding metal stents (SEMS) offer a valuable alternative to surgery. Stent therapy aims to achieve rapid control of oesophageal leakage, limit mediastinal contamination, and facilitate early sepsis control.

pmc-13243764.title: Heat Stroke Encephalopathy Without the Presence of Distinct Imaging Findings: Case Report and Review of Literature
pmc-13243764.creator: Ryan Sholes, David J Walz, Julia Evans, Tessa Connelly, Joseph Rigotti, Naohiro Komura
pmc-13243764.description: Heat stroke is a life‐threatening emergency characterized by severe hyperthermia and acute central nervous system (CNS) dysfunction. We describe a 72‐year‐old man who was found unresponsive in his vehicle on a day with ambient temperatures exceeding 90°F. On arrival, his core temperature was 105.8°F, and Glasgow Coma Scale (GCS) score was 5.

pmc-13297758.title: Comparative Analysis of the Chemical Composition of Hemp and Linseed Varieties as Key Industrial Commodities
pmc-13297758.creator: Tomáš Taubner, Michaela Englmaierová, Marie Bjelková, Věra Skřivanová, Klára Bejčková, Tomáš Vít, Kateřina Růnová
pmc-13297758.description: Hemp and linseed are nutritionally valuable commodities that exhibit considerable varietal differences in composition. Nutrient composition was evaluated in 12 hemp and 11 linseed varieties, including commercially cultivated varieties from the EU Common Catalogue and newly bred lines, to assess varietal variability.

pmc-13472519.title: A Case Series of Oral Cancer: An Enigma to Diagnosing Clinicians
pmc-13472519.creator: Ramachandra Reddy Gowda Venkatesha, Karthik Rajaram Mohan, Saramma Mathew Fenn, Reethika Rathan, Kumar Appusamy
pmc-13472519.description: Oral cancer is one of the most common health hazards encountered among the South Asian population. Oral cancer ranks sixth among other cancers worldwide. The risk factors for oral cancer are usually multifactorial, and the distribution of oral cancer varies according to ethnic origin.
